nav.label: Main navigation
column.name: Name
failure.login.long: This video needs you to be signed in. Sign in to YouTube in your browser and try again.
failure.refused.long: The video site refused the request. Try again in a minute, or open Settings → About → Update video support.
empty.all.heading: Nothing here yet
empty.all.body: Paste a link, or let the browser extension send downloads straight here.
empty.view.heading: No downloads in this view
empty.view.body: Everything is in another list. Try All downloads.
empty.search.heading: No matches
empty.search.body: No download name or address contains that text.
remove.title: Remove from the list?
remove.one: {name} will be removed from the list.
remove.many: {n} downloads will be removed from the list.
remove.deleteFile: Also delete the files from disk
restart.title: Restart from the beginning?
restart.body: {name} will be downloaded again from zero. Everything received so far is discarded.
duplicate.title: Already in the list
duplicate.body: {name} is already in your downloads, with the same link or the same name in the same folder.
add.title: Add download
add.urlHint: Paste a direct link. Riptide checks it as you type.
add.urlInvalid: That is not a web address. It should start with http:// or https://.
add.notResumable: single connection, the server does not support ranges
add.noSpace: Not enough space in this folder: {free} free
add.browseSoon: The folder picker arrives in a later version.
add.checksumInvalid: A checksum is 32, 40 or 64 hex characters.
details.title: Download details
details.rangesYes: The server accepts byte ranges, so each stripe is one connection and the file resumes from where it stopped.
details.rangesNo: The server does not accept byte ranges: one connection, and a resume starts from the beginning.
log.verifying: Checking the file against its checksum
toast.openSoon: Opening files arrives in a later version.
toast.browserFailed: Could not change the browser integration. Details are in the log.
toast.extFolderFailed: The extension folder was not found in this install.
toast.extPageFailed: Could not open the browser. Is it installed?
toast.updateCheckFailed: Could not check for updates. Details are in the log.
toast.updateFailed: The update could not be installed. Details are in the log.
settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Changes apply immediately.
settings.langDesc: Interface language. The layout mirrors for Arabic.
settings.defaultDirDesc: Where new downloads go unless their category says otherwise.
settings.categoryDirsDesc: Leave a row empty to use the default folder.
settings.connectionsDesc: More connections help on fast links; 8 is right for most servers.
settings.perHostDesc: A cap across all downloads from the same host, so servers do not block you.
settings.speedLimitDesc: Leave bandwidth for everything else on the network.
settings.clipboardMonitorDesc: Offer to download links you copy.
settings.notifyOnCompleteDesc: A Windows notification with Open and Show in folder.
settings.confirmOnExit: Ask before closing with active downloads
settings.confirmOnExitDesc: Downloads resume on the next start either way.
settings.closeToTray: Keep running in the tray when the window closes
settings.browserDesc: Catch downloads from Chrome, Edge and Firefox. No admin rights needed.
settings.ext: Install the extension in Chrome or Edge
settings.extDesc: Chrome and Edge load a local extension in three clicks. Riptide ships the folder; no store, no admin rights.
settings.extStep1: Open the extensions page and turn on Developer mode (top right).
settings.extStep3: Pick the Riptide extension folder (the button below opens it), then pin the Riptide icon.
settings.proxyDesc: Use the Windows proxy, none, or your own.
settings.proxyUrlInvalid: Use http://, https:// or socks5:// followed by host:port, e.g. socks5://127.0.0.1:1080
details.speedLimitDesc: For this download only; the global limit in Settings still applies.
exit.title: Quit Riptide?
exit.body: Pause {count} downloads and quit? They continue where they stopped the next time you open Riptide.
settings.aboutDesc: Free and open source. No accounts, no ads, no tracking.
settings.channel.prerelease: Pre-release builds follow the beta channel.
settings.autoUpdateDesc: At most once a day, from GitHub Releases. This is the only connection Riptide makes besides your downloads.
settings.resetDesc: Puts every setting back to its default. Downloads are not touched.
empty.steps.title: How to start
empty.step1.title: Paste a link
empty.step1.body: Press Ctrl+N, or use Add download.
empty.step2.title: Pick a folder and the connections
empty.step2.body: Riptide checks the link and fills in the name and category.
empty.step3.title: Watch the stripes fill
empty.step3.body: Each stripe is one connection fetching its part of the file.
shortcuts.title: Keyboard shortcuts
shortcuts.hint: Press ? anywhere to see this list again.
toast.autostartFailed: Could not change the Windows startup setting
add.mediaReady: Video found. Pick a quality below.
add.mediaPlainFallback: You can still add the link as a plain file.
add.mediaNoTools: Video support is not installed. Add it from Settings → About.
add.mediaDrm: This video is protected (DRM) and cannot be downloaded.
add.mediaLive: Live streams are not supported yet.
add.mediaUnsupported: Riptide could not find a downloadable video on this page.
add.mediaLogin: This video needs you to be signed in. Sign in to YouTube in your browser and try again.
add.mediaRefused: The video site refused the request. Try again in a minute, or open Settings → About → Update video support.
details.mediaHint: Video downloads are fetched and merged as a single file, so there is no per-connection map.
settings.videoMissing: Not installed. Update to download it.
settings.videoNoFfmpeg: yt-dlp {version} · ffmpeg missing (high qualities need it)
settings.videoPreview: Not available in the browser preview.
toast.videoUpdateFailed: Could not update video support. Details are in the log.
batch.title: Batch download
batch.patternHint: Use [001-120] for numbers, [a-z] for letters and [0-100:5] for steps. Several ranges multiply. Write \[ for a literal bracket.
batch.empty: Type a pattern to see the addresses it makes.
batch.listEmpty: Paste links or open a text file to see them here.
batch.error.not_http: The address must start with http:// or https://.
batch.error.invalid_char: The address contains a space or a character that is not allowed.
batch.error.unclosed: A [ has no closing ]. Write \[ for a plain bracket.
batch.error.invalid_range: That range is not valid. Examples: [1-10], [001-120], [a-z], [0-100:5].
batch.error.zero_step: The step must be at least 1.
batch.error.number_too_large: A number in the range is too large.
batch.error.too_many: This pattern makes more than {limit} links. Make the range smaller.
batch.ignored: {count} lines are not web addresses and were ignored
batch.addedSkipped: Added {added}; {skipped} skipped (already in the list or not valid)
batch.nothingAdded: Nothing was added: all {skipped} links are already in the list or not valid
queue.reorderHint: Drag to reorder, or press Alt + ↑ / ↓
queue.deleteBody: “{name}” will be deleted. Its {n} downloads move to the Main queue and keep their order. Nothing is deleted from your disk.
queue.deleteBodyEmpty: “{name}” will be deleted. It has no downloads.
queue.name: Name
queue.nameRequired: Enter a name for the queue.
queue.maxConcurrentMain: The Main queue follows the limit in Settings.
queue.moveNote: They go to the end of the queue you choose.
toast.queueDeleted: Queue deleted; its downloads are in the Main queue
shortcuts.moveInQueue: Move the selected download in its queue
schedule.title: Schedule
schedule.wraps: Runs overnight and stops the next morning.
schedule.startAt: Start once at a set date and time
schedule.startAtHint: The queue waits until then, and afterwards follows the hours above.
schedule.sleepNote: Riptide has to be running at that time. A sleeping or switched-off PC is not woken up: the queue starts as soon as the PC is on and Riptide is open.
schedule.issue.sameTime: Start and stop time must be different.
schedule.issue.startInPast: Choose a date and time in the future.
postaction.title: When the queue finishes
postaction.commandHint: Riptide starts exactly this program, with no options and no shell. Scripts (.bat, .cmd) are not run.
postaction.failed: The action could not be carried out: {error}
grab.title: Site grabber
grab.error.url: Enter a link that starts with http:// or https://
grab.error.size: Enter sizes as numbers of megabytes, with the smallest not above the largest.
grab.depthHint: How many links to follow from the start page. 0 reads only that page.
grab.offsite: Also list files hosted on other sites (a CDN, for example)
grab.typesHint: Leave all unticked to list every type.
grab.patternsHint: One pattern per line. * matches any name, ** matches folders too.
grab.sizeHint: Setting a size makes Riptide ask the server about every file, so the crawl takes longer.
grab.robots: Riptide always follows the site's robots.txt and keeps a polite pace. This cannot be turned off.
grab.stopped: Stopped. The files found so far are below.
grab.timeUp: Stopped: the time limit was reached.
grab.fileCap: The file limit was reached; some files are not listed.
grab.summary: {count} files will be added to your downloads.
menu.label: Application menu
shortcuts.jump: Jump to the first or last download
shortcuts.page: Move a page at a time
